turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
help you shop
First, make sure your eyelids and lashes are clean and oil-free using a cleanser like Pre-Cleanse.
menu
Brush a light coat of Whisper Light bond under your natural lashes, concentrating at the roots, and wait 30–60 seconds until it becomes tacky.
Place the Gossamer lashes 1mm to 2mm above your waterline using your fingers or the Fuse Control Wand, then clamp gently down with the wand to fuse them into place!
